description:
The authorship gate `substrate/hooks/pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh` (deployed to `.claude/hooks/`) FALSE-POSITIVES on prose + seat-attribution lines, treating them as structured author fields and rejecting the value because it is not a bare allow-listed identity. Blocked the Arc-61 close-gate housekeeping commit TWICE:

1. VERA verdict file `agents/verdicts/stoa--p41.1/VERA-*.md` — its V7 authorship-AUDIT prose line `expected: html author = Denson Smith; no other person in any author field` was parsed as an `author` field with value "Denson Smith; no other person in any author field".
2. `substrate/arcs/arc-61-build-directive.md:4` — the directive seat-attribution line `**Authored by:** user-tier POLYBIUS (chief-of-staff) + the PRINCIPAL (Denson Smith).` was parsed as a `by` field with the seat-inclusive value.

NEITHER is a real violation: the only real PERSON named in both is Denson Smith (already allow-listed); "user-tier POLYBIUS" is a SEAT, not another person. The gate cannot distinguish (a) structured frontmatter `author:` fields from (b) prose containing "author" or markdown "**Authored by:**" lines.

DECISION FOR PRINCIPAL (gate vs convention):
(a) RECOMMENDED — narrow the gate matcher to only structured frontmatter/`author:`-style fields at line start, NOT markdown "**Authored by:**" prose nor mid-prose "author = X". Convention stays as-is (correct; Denson always named, no false person).
(b) change the directive seat-attribution convention repo-wide.
(c) path-exempt agents/verdicts/ + agents/save-verdict/ + directive "Authored by:" lines.

DEPENDENCY: the Arc-61 directive-DoD correction is committed-but-blocked — it sits in `git stash@{0}` on the-stoa main. Once the gate is reconciled, pop the stash and land the directive-DoD fix (3 lines: DoD #1 + O1/D5 echoes "subproject dry-run" -> "real (non-dry-run) subproject recompose (probe V3)").

Fixing the gate is a substrate change (substrate/hooks/) = its own small arc. Surfaced at the Arc-61 close.

During Arc 64, PLINY's trailing in-tree verdict-record commit was BLOCKED because the gate mis-parsed CATO's authorship-AUDIT prose ('Author: Denson Smith with a DAEDALUS seat breadcrumb...' inside the verdict body) as a literal author field. Recommend this raises z2b priority. Anchor: Arc 64 PLINY hand-back item 1, CATO verdict authorship-AUDIT prose.
